children: Berlin: Commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal Friday discussed issues related to investment opportunities in India with German majors Siemens Healthineers, Bayer and Fresenius.

During his meeting with Stefan Oelrich, president of the Pharmaceuticals Division at Bayer, Goyal said he discussed the company's expansion plans in India and opportunities to deepen its engagement with the country's robust healthcare ecosystem through greater investment, innovation and collaboration. "Had a fruitful meeting with Mr.

Michael Sen, CEO of Fresenius Group. Discussed opportunities to deepen collaboration in healthcare, leveraging India's rapidly expanding healthcare sector, growing demand for quality and affordable medical solutions, and strong manufacturing capabilities," Goyal said in a social media post. He explored how the group can harness India's skilled talent to serve domestic and global markets. The minister discussed strengthening Siemens Healthineers' presence in India.

title: Goyal Discusses Investment Avenues with German Cos
